page.layout: One block of text on a single printed page: heading PRÆFATIO at top centre, then a justified paragraph in italic and roman; below it a dedicatory line, the name RODOLPHVS HOSPINIANVS with Tigurinus, and a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.

main_text.head: PRÆFATIO
main_text.p: ꝛ hanc historiam in suam tutelam, patrocinium ac defensionem suscipere dignetur, Altera Dedicationis hujus causa est, quòd non solum in Marchia, seu Ditione ac Dominio V. toto verbi diuini doctrina splendidissimè lucet, eamq; magna animi fortitudine, magnoq; zelo ac singulari studio Celsitudo V. defendit & propagat: quod si in eò perrexerit, DEVM omnipotentem remuneratorem largissimum experietur, neque is Vestro studio, laboribus & sanctis conatibus unquam deerit: apud cunctos autem Veritatis Evangelicæ amantes æternam laudem & gloriam consequetur. Tertia causa est, ut Historia hæc manifestum ac certum sit quasi depositum, testimonium & signum S. P. Q. Tigurini erga Celsitud. Vestram summæ observantiæ, studij & amoris singularis. Quod reliquum est, DEVM Opt. Max. ex animo oro rogóque, ut Celsitudini Vestræ in hac vita contingat optata longævitas: in fide Christi perennis stabilitas: in Imperio firma tranquillitas, in obitu felix immortalitas: in cœlis autem expectata beatitas: per IESVM CHRISTVM Dominum ac Servatorem nostrum unicum, ✠Amen. Tiguri Helvetiorum Metropoli 28. Octobris, anno Christi Salvatoris nostri unici 1619.
main_text.head: Celsitudinis V. observantissimus

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (decorative heraldic-style emblem) below the dedication; no printed text. The first line of the paragraph carries a decorative initial mark. Some words in the dedication are uncertain due to the scan; the opening word "ꝛ" may be a printer's mark for "Ut" or similar.
